question.html:
Two positive electric charges of magnitudes q and 4q are a distance d apart, along a line L.

a

X is a point along L where the electric field E due to the charges is zero.

Show that X is at a distance d from the largest charge.

[2]

b.i

N is just displaced along L, closer to q, and released.

Explain the subsequent motion of N.

[1]

b.ii

N is just displaced upwards, perpendicularly to L, and released.

Explain the subsequent motion of N.
